subQuests.subQuestName: Go to The Court of the Millennial Pearl Seahorse

746820101.text: So we're here in the end...

746820103.text: When I became an adult, I finally understood why the Forest Watchers had made those faces they did...

746820104.text: *cough* But anyway, I gave it my best shot.

746820105.text: I also learned that you should never bring unprocessed Pyro Regisvine fruit near a Jadeplume Terrorshroom...

746820106.text: By the time I smelled something burning, it was already too late. Barely avoided drowning in the spores it poured forth.

746820107.text: It's easy to forget, sometimes, that Fungi are a completely different species from Shroomboars.

746820108.text: Anyway, speaking of which, they actually are a type of fungus, right?

746820109.text: That's right, and they taste especially delicious in soups.

746820110.text: But anyway, let's get back to today's challenge.

746820111.text: Well, I haven't figured out what to cook ye... Oh! Right, uh, you mean the "negotiations." Sorry.

746820112.text: Perhaps you've heard the story of the two Fontemer Aberrant overlords? It speaks of how the Millennial Pearl Seahorse is described as being "proud" and "noble."

746820113.text: By contrast, the Emperor of Fire and Iron seems to be a fierce, cruel being, strong but brutal.

746820114.text: And here Paimon thought you'd pick the tougher opponent. After all, wouldn't a stronger opponent make for a cooler story?

746820115.text: That is true, but the Emperor is a heavily-armored crab... While the other party's a seahorse that flies!

746820117.text: Wait, is that the question we should be asking right now?

746820119.text: Still, if I could only ride it, even once...

746820120.text: Well, sure then. Looks like you're sticking this one out to the end.

746820121.text: Well, we are here, aren't we? Surely we can't leave empty-handed? Anyway, let's head out once you're ready.
